g.text: Calderon RNA: branch identity versus cell-state labels
Preliminary reconstruction | 0-18 h | 184 assigned temporal states | 314,387 cells
Merging labels barely reduces node count
53 -> 49 labels; 32/53 branches contain multiple cell-state names.
222 witnessed type pairs; 604 after closing the merged graph.
*Broad-decoder depth is graph depth; merging can extend paths.
Current repo: Maizels 9 types / 8 edges / depth 4; CITE-Multi 7 types / 6 edges / depth 1.
Graphs are reconstructed from released IDs and annotations, not the complete weighted Fig. 3C edge export.
All arrows shown are direct non-self edges. Full node labels, edge tables and construction rules accompany these figures.
